name: Mechanical Engineering Technology
description: Mechanical engineering technology programmes train the people who test, build and improve mechanical systems — measurement and instrumentation, hydraulics and pneumatics, manufacturing processes, CAD and the quality methods around them.
degreesNote: An associate degree (A.S. or A.A.S.), usually two years, and at several Florida colleges a route into a bachelor's in engineering technology. ⚠⚠ As with every technology degree on this site: it is accredited by ABET's ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY commission, which under Florida law means SIX years of experience before a PE rather than four. ⚠ The occupation itself is unusual in what it expects — 37% of O*NET's respondents said a BACHELOR'S degree is required against 14% an associate — so read the job adverts where you live before assuming the two-year degree is the finish line.

cips.note: Mechanical engineering related technologies — 13 Florida public institutions: 15.0803 (automotive engineering technology) at six with 187 credentials and 15.0801 (mechanical engineering technology) at five with 88.

related.note: The umbrella series — 76 institutions, and where to look for the neighbouring branches of the same family.
